sv.title: Asmodees tidigare vd dumpar aktier – kursen faller
sv.summary: Asmodees styrelseledamot Stéphane Carville, som tidigare varit vd för Asmodee, har halverat sitt innehav i bolaget. Aktien handlas ned med 6 procent.

en.title: Asmodee's former CEO dumps shares – share price falls
en.summary: Asmodee board member Stéphane Carville, who was previously CEO of Asmodee, has halved his holding in the company. The share is trading down 6 percent.
